analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear – a fully automated carpet cleaning solution addresses a specific pain point. The AI-based perception is a minor differentiator.', 'Impact and Evidence Plan': '• Limited – The impact is primarily convenience and reduced cleaning costs.
